slug: 2026-02-24 Nigeria, Equatorial Guinea subsea cable strengthens connectivity

facts.fact: Connecting Africa reports that Backbone Connectivity Network Nigeria and Equatorial Guinea's transport and telecommunications minister signed a subsea fibre-optic agreement in Malabo in February 2026 for a direct high-capacity Nigeria-Equatorial Guinea link plus a commercial data centre, with specifications, investment and timelines undisclosed.
